description.narrative: A joint resolution submitted by the major Trade Unions to the President, Prime Minister and Labour Ministry for the inclusive response to the present economic and political crisis which protects the employment and continuation of business got support attention from the media and society about the root cause of the crisis and for an inclusive response. A trade union advisory committee has been formed to guide labour migration activities related to migrant workers' rights and protection. Trade Unions' joint demands for an effective tripartite consultation on the proposed labour law reform are considered by the National Labour Advisory Council to discuss the draft law. The ILO with the support with support from the Government of Switzerland facilitated the dialogue to form the advisory committee

Output 1.2. Increased institutional capacity of workers’ organizations

description.narrative: The National Union of Seafarers (NUSS) provided training services to returned migrant workers, which benefitted. - 22 seafarers and 15 crane operators, out of which 17 seafarers already placed in employment and 05 are in On-the-Job Training. 8 Females are continuing the workplace-based training at the Mahapola Marine Training Institute, at the Sri Lanka Ports Authority as crane operators. 8 of them were employed in the Port after completing the training. NUSS Formed committees for labour migration activities including the following: 1) a trade union advisory committee consisting of seven union leaders to guide labour migration activities related to migrants’ rights protection; 2) A 14-member trade union technical committee developed a training toolkit on migrants’ rights protection NUSS adopted four training programmes implemented in April and May 2023, designed for the following: 1) State-Level Trade Union Members to capacitate TU members to understand OSH, Basic Risk Assessment, Incident recording and reporting to Young Trade Union Leaders, Proactive measures, and build related capacity to handle OSH at ground level; 2) Young Trade Union Leaders to capacitate TU members to understand OSH, OSH Convention, Risk assessment and analysis, Incident review and reporting, negotiation skills, and Action Plan development; 3) Key Trade Union Leaders to capacitate leaders to understand OSH, OSH FPRW, and OSH strategies development, Capacitate in Proactive and reactive measures, Incident review, and action plan development Engaged with NUSS and trained returned and aspirant migrant workers in Marine sector. ILO provided technical support, especially on safe labour migration, and reintegration support. This included technical support for curricula and the On-the-Job Development curricula. ILO provided access to the toolkit for workers' training programme.
